title: Match static v1 operations before parameter routes

endpoints.before: The gateway could attribute requests for a static path overlapping /v1/offers/{id} to getOffer before examining /v1/offers/latest-released.
endpoints.after: Static registry paths take precedence over parameter paths. Requests to /v1/offers/{id} use their actual registered operation for permission scopes, expensive-operation limits, analytics and durable endpoint history matching; the origin URL and response contract are unchanged.
